about: This form is not fillable, so nothing but the page says what its fields are; set by hand, read off the page. Page 1 is the report. Taken away: the frame above the claim number, two empty cells of the layout, and the boxes at the right edge the insurer fills in. Page 3 is the copy of page 1 for the employer's files (the pipeline had made fields of the letters of its watermark), page 4 the pharmacy's slip, which repeats the head of page 1 and is filled in by the pharmacy: neither is asked. Their pages stay empty in the output; a copy that takes the values of the page it repeats is not built. Added: postcode and place, the date and time of the accident (one date instead of the boxes for day, month and year), the two entries of section 8, the kind of injury, place and date, and the signature. The boxes of the position and of the side are one choice each, of which one is ticked. Applied by tools/correct.js. Where the model's question was wrong, did not hold or spoke to the wrong person, the question was written by hand (all questions of the form were read on 11 October 2026).
